verdict.rationale: Expensify ships a conversational AI that can create, categorize, approve and reject expenses in plain language, build rules on request, and answer questions about account data. This is the conversational base the story needs, but nothing shows it enforcing policy proactively or before spend happens. Missing for 10: evidence of chasing missing receipts, conversational explanations of declines or rejections, pre-spend "can I expense this?" policy answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant.
